title: Holomap Rail Composition: Adaptive Scope Lens & Compact Workspace Flow
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: The Console currently exposes multiple entry surfaces (left rail, top nav, workspace chips) that compete for attention and lead to task fragmentation when users jump between dashboards, rollouts, and cost views. This causes repeated context-switching and inconsistent affordances for multi-tenant workflows.

Goal: Propose a cohesive information architecture and compact navigation pattern — Holomap Rail + Scope Lens — that reduces clicks-to-target, preserves role-aware affordances, and supports progressive reveal for advanced controls (rollouts, cost lenses, routing rules). The design should be keyboard-first, accessible (WCAG AA), and incrementally deployable behind feature flags.

What this ticket contains: a design proposal, annotated wireframes, an interactive Figma prototype (holomap/ScopeLens), a high-level engineering feasibility note, rollout phasing, and success metrics to evaluate impact. Includes discussion of fallbacks for Private/Dedicated deployments where workspace metadata may be restricted.
acceptance_criteria: New Holomap rail pattern defined with primary/secondary affordances and keyboard navigation spec
Scope Lens workspace switcher prototypes validated in Figma with at least 3 usability test sessions (internal) showing reduced time-to-task
Engineering feasibility doc reviewed and a minimal viable launch plan (feature-flag + 10% A/B) agreed
Telemetry spec created: clicks-to-target, route-latency, nav-dropoff, role-based access-paths
Accessibility checklist completed with contrast ratios, focus order, and ARIA landmarks specified

design_decisions:
- Use a two-tier rail: primary nodes (dashboards, chat, models, rollouts, cost) and context lanes that surface per-workspace tools.
- Workspace switching uses a Scope Lens overlay that preserves recent context and supports anchored pinning.
- Rollouts live as inline cards within the holo-pane to avoid full route changes for common ops.
- Cost views surface token-level badges with drilldown to route-level breakdowns.
- Keyboard shortcuts: 'g' to open Holomap, arrow keys to move lanes, 'Enter' to open Scope Lens.
- Accessibility: always maintain focus order and provide skip-to-content from rail.
